name: token-ledger
description: Records token use, tools, commands and issues per task type, and recommends (or applies) the cheapest reliable model and effort for similar jobs

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: record: log only. suggest: log and show the cheapest reliable model/effort. auto: also switch model/effort for the turn.

minSamples.title: Minimum samples
minSamples.description: Runs of one model/effort on a task type before it can be recommended

minSavingsPct.title: Minimum savings (%)
minSavingsPct.description: Recommend a change only when its median cost is at least this much lower

modelWeights.title: Model price weights
modelWeights.description: Relative price per token by model name fragment, e.g. haiku=1,sonnet=3,opus=5. Empty compares raw weighted tokens.

logPath.title: JSONL mirror path
logPath.description: If set, every recorded turn rewrites this JSONL file (full local records, including paths and error text: keep it out of any public repository). A relative path resolves against Claude Code's working folder; ~ is not expanded.

shareDir.title: Shared folder
shareDir.description: Absolute path of a folder all your machines see (e.g. inside the OneDrive hub). Each session writes a trimmed records file there (no paths, commands or error text) and every machine reads them all. The mod never runs git or uses the network.
